description: This file contains Kotlin source code for managing contacts within an Android application. It defines data structures for contacts and requests, implements a data source interface with an Android-specific implementation, and provides a handler class for searching and adding contacts via JSON input/output, including permission checks.

classes.name: ContactRecord
classes.description: Data class representing a contact with identifier, display name, name components, organization, phone numbers, and emails.

classes.name: ContactsSearchRequest
classes.description: Data class encapsulating search parameters for contacts, including query string and result limit.

classes.name: ContactsAddRequest
classes.description: Data class encapsulating details for adding a new contact, including name, organization, phone numbers, and emails.

classes.name: ContactsDataSource
classes.description: Interface defining methods for permission checking, searching, and adding contacts.

classes.name: SystemContactsDataSource
classes.description: Android-specific implementation of ContactsDataSource, performing contact queries and insertions via ContentResolver.

classes.name: ContactsHandler
classes.description: Main handler class facilitating contact search and add operations, parsing JSON parameters and returning JSON responses, with permission validation.

methods.name: hasReadPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has permission to read contacts.

methods.name: hasWritePermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has permission to write contacts.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a contact search based on a query and limit, returning a list of ContactRecords.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new contact based on provided details, returning the created ContactRecord.

methods.name: handleContactsSearch
methods.description: Handles a JSON request to search contacts; returns a GatewaySession result with contact list or error.

methods.name: handleContactsAdd
methods.description: Handles a JSON request to add a contact; returns a GatewaySession result indicating success or failure.

methods.name: parseSearchRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON input into a ContactsSearchRequest object.

methods.name: parseAddRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON input into a ContactsAddRequest object.

methods.name: stringArray
methods.description: Converts a JsonArray to a list of strings, trimming whitespace.

methods.name: contactJson
methods.description: Serializes a ContactRecord into a JsonObject for output.
